claims.claim: When accepting requires a re-pick, the override rate misstates real corrections.
claims.detail: pick-to-accept, 20 seeds: override rate 14.9%, real corrections 9.4%; 37% of overrides changed nothing (range 33%–42%); re-picks alone were 24% of all overrides. Representative (median) run: seed 11.
claims.post_wording: Production observation; the lab only illustrates the mechanism. Quote the mean, not one run.

claims.claim: The share of overrides that aren't corrections depends on hold rate, bulk use and review habits.
Bulk 'set category' loses real corrections (stamps AI errors as human-confirmed).
claims.detail: Paired over 20 seeds: +1.11pp of documents corrected without bulk (t = 16.3). Direction is built into the bulk model; size depends on bulk usage.
claims.post_wording: Mechanism, not a measured effect size.

claims.claim: corrections ÷ all suggestions is a lower bound on true error (if reviewers are right).
claims.detail: Holds in 101/108 cells: reviewer accuracy 85–97%, wrong items opened 15–80%, correct items opened 2–40%, threshold 0.80/0.90, bulk use 0/20%. Tightest cell: gap -3.6pp (reviewers 85%, open-if-wrong 80%, open-if-right 40%). Default: 8.6% vs true 19.2%.
claims.post_wording: Lower bound if reviewers' corrections are right; can fail with weak reviewers at very high review coverage.

claims.claim: Reviewed-subset error is biased; it is not a bound.
claims.detail: Overstates in 106/108 cells, because every cell triggers review by low confidence or breakage. Review driven by value or random QA can understate.
claims.post_wording: Never call it an upper bound.

claims.claim: A blind stratified audit recovers the true error rate.
claims.detail: 98% labellers, double-labelled, reviewed items re-audited blind: bias -0.0 to +0.1pp across AI error rates of ~4/19/37%, coverage 95%–100%. 90% labellers: single label +3.8 to +9.4pp; second label on disagreement -4.4 to +0.6pp (sign flips with the base rate); double-label everything +0.8 to +2.4pp; gold-slice Rogan–Gladen correction -0.3 to +2.3pp, coverage 80%–88% (gold-slice uncertainty not propagated). If labellers drop to 75% on ambiguous look-alikes (errors correlated across labellers): double-labelled bias -0.3pp, coverage 92%; gold-corrected +0.1pp.
claims.post_wording: Recovers it with good blind labellers. With weaker labellers every shortcut is biased in a base-rate-dependent way: improve labellers and measure them against a gold slice.

claims.claim: A match-strength score is confidently wrong on look-alikes.
claims.detail: Twin errors at ≥0.9: match-strength 42%, margin 0% (by arithmetic: margin can't exceed 0.57 on look-alike families), classifier 1%. Within look-alike families (pooled) no score separates right from wrong much: AUROC match-strength 0.73, margin 0.76, classifier 0.78.
claims.post_wording: Don't claim margin 'ranks twins better' — it works by pushing whole look-alike families below the rest.

claims.claim: At equal workload, treating look-alike families differently beats one global threshold.
claims.detail: Errors passed automatically at 20/33/50% held, exactly in expectation (randomised gate at the boundary), mean of 20 seeds — match-strength, one global threshold: 11.0%/7.1%/4.2%; match-strength, threshold on look-alike families only: 10.5%/6.4%/3.1%; match-strength + look-alike evidence check: n/a/5.9%/3.4%; margin score, one global threshold: 9.0%/5.8%/2.0%; classifier, 300 labels: 12.6%/7.5%/2.9%; classifier, 3,000 labels: 8.6%/4.3%/0.9%. The ranking changes with the budget; magnitudes come from the generator. The rules are built from the generator's own vocabulary (an upper bound on hand-written rules); the classifiers are untuned.
claims.post_wording: Show all budgets; say the ranking depends on budget; disclose label budgets.

claims.claim: Joining overrides to suggestions by filename loses and misattributes ground truth.
claims.detail: Interleaved timeline, 10 seeds: 28% ambiguous; latest-draft-wins wrong 6% (grid 0%–26%). Magnitudes depend on the assumed filename collision rate; the direction holds whenever names collide. ID join: 100%.
claims.post_wording: Quote as a range; the size is an assumption.
